tasks.title: Conversation #109
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I'm having trouble with my internet connection. It keeps dropping every few minutes.
Man: That's frustrating. Have you contacted your service provider?
Woman: Yes, I called them this morning. They said they'd send a technician out tomorrow.
Man: Hopefully they can fix it quickly.
Woman: I hope so. I have an important video conference scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.
Man: Make sure to let them know about that. Maybe they can prioritize your request.

questions.stem: What is the woman's problem with her Internet?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士的互联网出了什么问题？ 定位原文：Woman: I'm having trouble with my internet connection. It keeps dropping every few minutes. 选项分析： A. It is too slow. 网速太慢。对话中提到的是连接中断（dropping），而不是速度慢，所以A选项错误。 B. It keeps disconnecting. 它一直断连。女士明确说“keeps dropping every few minutes”（每隔几分钟就断一次），所以B选项正确。 C. It is not secure. 它不安全。对话中未提及网络安全问题，所以C选项错误。 D. It has a weak signal. 信号弱。对话中未提及信号强度，只说了连接中断，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man advise the woman to do?

options.D: Let a technician know about a video conference

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：男士建议女士做什么？ 定位原文：Man: Make sure to let them know about that. Maybe they can prioritize your request. 选项分析： A. Reschedule her meeting 重新安排她的会议。男士没有建议改时间，而是建议联系技术人员说明情况，所以A选项错误。 B. Buy a new router 买一个新路由器。对话中未提及路由器，所以B选项错误。 C. Change her service provider 更换她的服务商。对话中未建议更换供应商，所以C选项错误。 D. Let a technician know about a video conference 让技术人员知道有个视频会议。男士明确说“let them know about that”（把视频会议的事告诉他们），这样他们可能会优先处理，所以D选项正确。
